page.layout: Two coin engravings side by side at the top, centred on the text block. Below them one column of running text in two paragraphs. Signature "Ggg" at the foot, right. Running head at the top, page number at top right.

main_text.p: VALENTINIANVS tertius, Constantio & Placidia genitus, ab Honorio cum matre pulsus, in oriente proficiscitur, à Theodosio iuniore suscipitur: subinde mortuo ipso Honorio, Eudoxia Theodosij filia in vxore accepta, Romam opportunè missus, Ioannem tyrannum obterit: à Theodosio Augustus appellatur, Romæque Imperat, anno mundi 4329. à Christo nato 427. cum Genserico statim fœdus init, parte Africæ, vt videri voluit, cōtento: & aduersus Attilam Aëtij ductu, feliciter confixit: quem Aëtium postea iussit occidi: à cuius militibus, in vltionē, ipse Imperator paulò post occiditur. Hoc principe Fræci[?] Gallias, Angli & Scoti Britanniam occupant. Vandali Africam populantur. Hunni Europam vexant & Italiam: tunc imperium Romanum funditus est collapsum ad Carolum magnū vsque: nihilominus tamen interea Constantinopolitani Imperatores, Romanos se quoque Imperatores nuncupabant. imperauit annos 30. Pomp. Læ. Egna. Pau. Dic. lib. 5.

MARTIANVS humili loco natus, militia tamen clarus, Pulcheriæ Archadij filiæ opera, Constantinopoli, post Theodosium primum admodū senex imperauit. Cum Vandalis fœdus percussit: arma nunquam nisi prouocatus mouit: dicere solitus, Non decere principē arma sumere, dum licet ei in pace viuere. Is Talia-num Iuliúmque (ambo fratres erant, qui eum olim ægrum hospitio susceperāt, & aquilæ superuolantis eius caput, auspicium retexerant, viaticóque 200. aureorū inopē & ægrum recrearāt) statim vt princeps est dictus, illum Constantinopoli, hunc Illyrico præfecit. Imperauit Martianus annis septem, auspicatus anno mundi 4413. à Christo nato 451. Vide vt supra.

page.notes: Two engraved coin medallions at the top, not text. Left medallion: a bust of a man facing right, with the legend "IMP.C.VALENTINIANVS P.F.AVG.III" around the rim. Right medallion: a laureate bust facing right, with the legend "MARTIANVS P.F.AVG." around the rim and "IMP" at the bottom; the rim legend is only partly legible on the scan. "Fræci" is uncertain: the ligature may read "Fraci" or "Fræci". The coin legends are part of the engraving and are not transcribed as text.
